NEOW_BLESSING.title: Neow's Blessing
NEOW_BLESSING.description:
Upon pickup, gain [blue]120[/blue] Max HP.
Lose all potion slots.
At the start of each turn, draw [blue]2[/blue] fewer cards and lose [blue]1[/blue] Energy.
Whenever you enter a new act, gain [blue]180[/blue] Max HP.
At the start of combat, gain a special effect.
NEOW_BLESSING.eventDescription: [gold]Neow's Blessing[/gold]: gain [blue]120[/blue] Max HP and explain your enormous health pool — but your turns become smaller.
NEOW_BLESSING.flavor: A blessing measured in blood and restraint.
